guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 创建你的 PayBox 账户
guide.description: 前往 PayBox 并使用你的邮箱注册。你不需要 MoonPay 账户。选择 Claude 或 ChatGPT 作为你的助手并复制连接器 URL：https://api.paybox.sh/mcp
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to PayBox and sign up with your email. You do not need a MoonPay account. Pick Claude or ChatGPT as your assistant and copy the connector URL: https://api.paybox.sh/mcp

guide.title: 将 PayBox 连接器添加到你的 AI 助手
guide.description: 每个平台的设置略有不同： ChatGPT：在 ChatGPT 网站上（移动应用中不提供开发人员模式），打开“设置”，在“安全”下启用开发人员模式，然后转到“插件”，选择“新建插件”，将其命名为 PayBox，粘贴服务器 URL，并将身份验证设置为 OAuth。 Claude：从 PayBox 站点选择“打开 Claude 设置”，连接器应该显示为预填充的；选择“添加”。如果未显示，请转到“设置”，然后转到“连接器”，然后添加一个名为 PayBox 且具有相同 URL 的自定义连接器。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Add the PayBox Connector to Your AI Assistant
guide.original_description: The setup differs slightly per platform: ChatGPT: On the ChatGPT website (Developer mode is unavailable in the mobile app), open Settings, enable Developer mode under Security, then go to Plugins, select New Plugin, name it PayBox, paste the server URL, and set Authentication to OAuth. Claude: Select “Open Claude Settings” from the PayBox site, and the connector should appear pre-filled; select “Add.” If it does not show up, go to Settings, then Connectors, and add a custom connector named PayBox with the same URL.

guide.title: 使用密钥授权 PayBox
guide.description: 保存连接器，选择“连接”，完成 OAuth 授权。出现提示时注册密钥。然后 PayBox 为你创建一个 Solana 钱包和一个 EVM 钱包。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Save the connector, select Connect, and complete the OAuth authorization. Register a passkey when prompted. PayBox then creates a Solana wallet and an EVM wallet for you.

guide.title: 在聊天中测试连接
guide.description: 开始对话并询问你的助理“@PayBox 检查我的余额”。按照提示完成钱包设置并确认代理可以到达你的金库。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Start a conversation and ask your assistant “@PayBox check my balance”. Follow the prompts to finish wallet setup and confirm the agent can reach your vault.

guide.title: 验证仪表盘上的所有内容
guide.description: 打开 PayBox 仪表盘并使用你的密码登录。你的 AI 平台应列在“代理”下，两个钱包应列在“凭证”下。如果缺少某些东西，请在水龙头投入使用之前重新连接。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the PayBox Dashboard and sign in with your passkey. Your AI platform should be listed under Agents and both wallets under Credentials. If something is missing, reconnect before the faucet goes live.

guide.title: 连接 X 并领取 USDC 掉落
guide.description: 水龙头重新打开后，在仪表盘上找到“领取你的 USDC 掉落”，选择“连接 X”并授权你的账户。显示你的分配情况，USDC 将进入你的 PayBox Solana 钱包。 MoonPay 已确认错过第一轮的用户将获得另一次机会。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect X and Claim the USDC Drop
guide.original_description: Once the faucet reopens, find “Claim your USDC drop” on the dashboard, select Connect X, and authorize your account. Reveal your allocation and the USDC lands in your PayBox Solana wallet. MoonPay has confirmed that users who missed round one will get another chance.

sourcedSteps.title: Create Your PayBox Account
sourcedSteps.body: Go to PayBox and sign up with your email. You do not need a MoonPay account. Pick Claude or ChatGPT as your assistant and copy the connector URL: https://api.paybox.sh/mcp

sourcedSteps.title: Add the PayBox Connector to Your AI Assistant
sourcedSteps.body: The setup differs slightly per platform: ChatGPT: On the ChatGPT website (Developer mode is unavailable in the mobile app), open Settings, enable Developer mode under Security, then go to Plugins, select New Plugin, name it PayBox, paste the server URL, and set Authentication to OAuth. Claude: Select “Open Claude Settings” from the PayBox site, and the connector should appear pre-filled; select “Add.” If it does not show up, go to Settings, then Connectors, and add a custom connector named PayBox with the same URL.

sourcedSteps.title: Authorize PayBox With a Passkey
sourcedSteps.body: Save the connector, select Connect, and complete the OAuth authorization. Register a passkey when prompted. PayBox then creates a Solana wallet and an EVM wallet for you.

sourcedSteps.title: Test the Connection in Chat
sourcedSteps.body: Start a conversation and ask your assistant “@PayBox check my balance”. Follow the prompts to finish wallet setup and confirm the agent can reach your vault.

sourcedSteps.title: Verify Everything on the Dashboard
sourcedSteps.body: Open the PayBox Dashboard and sign in with your passkey. Your AI platform should be listed under Agents and both wallets under Credentials. If something is missing, reconnect before the faucet goes live.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect X and Claim the USDC Drop
sourcedSteps.body: Once the faucet reopens, find “Claim your USDC drop” on the dashboard, select Connect X, and authorize your account. Reveal your allocation and the USDC lands in your PayBox Solana wallet. MoonPay has confirmed that users who missed round one will get another chance.
